objective: Implement deterministic position-level broker/reference reconciliation between the exact current P21-A canonical position and an explicit normalized reference/sandbox broker-position observation, failing safe on every mismatch without duplicating P20-G order reconciliation or mutating broker/OMS/canonical state.
scope: Bind every observation to the exact current P21-A position_record_id
Accept explicit caller-supplied normalized reference/sandbox broker-position observations only
Support OPEN, PARTIALLY_CLOSED and CLOSED canonical positions
Support OPEN and NOT_FOUND external position observations
Reject observations older than the current canonical position record
Compare position identity, asset, market, fixed-point scales, side, open quantity and average entry exactly
Use zero hidden tolerance; one fixed-point unit difference is a mismatch
Return deterministic MATCHED, MISSING_EXTERNAL_POSITION, EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE_CONFLICT, IDENTITY_MISMATCH, SIDE_MISMATCH, QUANTITY_MISMATCH, ENTRY_PRICE_MISMATCH or MULTIPLE_MISMATCH verdicts
Require SAFE_HOLD and NEW_ENTRY_BLOCK for every non-MATCHED verdict
Require MANUAL_GOVERNED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED for every non-MATCHED verdict
Carry current P21-A source OMS/reconciliation lineage into the reconciliation report
Produce deterministic content-addressed reports and byte-identical P21-F evidence
out_of_scope: Selecting a production broker or venue
Automatically repairing broker, OMS or P21-A position state
Automatically flattening or reducing a mismatched position
Broker-side order placement, cancellation or modification
tests: Matching OPEN reference observation returns MATCHED
CLOSED canonical position plus NOT_FOUND observation returns MATCHED
Open canonical position plus NOT_FOUND returns MISSING_EXTERNAL_POSITION
Closed canonical position plus OPEN observation returns EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE_CONFLICT
Identity, side, quantity and average-entry mismatches are deterministic and fail safe
One fixed-point unit quantity or entry difference is a mismatch
Observation timestamp older than current canonical record fails closed
Every mismatch requires SAFE_HOLD + NEW_ENTRY_BLOCK + manual governed reconciliation
No auto-repair, auto-flatten, venue query, OMS mutation, canonical mutation or Live authority is emitted
P21-F evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P21-F package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P21-A through P21-E remain canonical complete and P21-G remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Exact lineage/fixed-point and safe-hold mismatch tests pass
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
Implementation PR merged and post-merge verified
